title: Compress the ordinary events of the PR5907 P104 word: 25,998 to 25,861, same invoice
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spL?thread=cmsg_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spLBZyzUpc7iqr1PnUJEsEz1u)_

## Change and mathematical scope

Tooling and a rewritten word, no new κ. The latest conditional P104 word (PR #5907, κ 0.003125282) sits at 25,998 of the retained 26,000-event cap, which its author names as the main constraint on further steps. Three semantics-preserving peephole passes over its ordinary events (merge adjacent `ADD r <- s` with no intervening touch, merge consecutive `SCALE r`, drop writes into owned fields that are CLEARed before being read) free **137 events** (25,861 remain). Every MOVE, INIT and CLEAR event, every chart, every owned lifetime, all 799 endpoint rows and the complete paid and helper profiles are unchanged, so the invoice and κ are unchanged. The author's scalar allowance falls from 228,664 to 227,372 units.

The package README also records a bounded negative search done with that headroom: no further PR5786-style asynchronous hub on this word has a positive complete bill (298 feasible frame/helper/cut triples, all needing paid query subdivisions; best −0.00051 in the local moment at the PR5907 exponent), and no rank-two block of two helpers sharing at most four subdivisions (the S09 route of the #5803 atlas) exists; five or more subdivisions always exceed the two-helper gain.

Remaining obligations: the five inherited framework assumptions of the P104 line; PR5907's native maps, physical caller, compiler and outer checks are not rerun here (their inputs are shown equal).

## Task and overlap

Base `19fdb086ea96af9a9f87936a2b888e10af4ed810`. Card `p104-side-correction`, scope refined (side result on the latest conditional word; the binding constraint was the event cap, not a helper basis). Inputs: `research/p104-helper468-rung-removal/WORD.json.gz` (PR #5907), `research/p104-unread-path-resynthesis/local.py` (PR #5827 checker, loaded unmodified). Nearest work: PR #5907 (rung removal, +14 events), PR #5786 (hubs, +27 events each), PR #5827; none compresses ordinary events. Package: `research/p104-ordinary-event-compression`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B research/p104-ordinary-event-compression/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-ordinary-event-compression
```

About six seconds, standard library only, Python 3.12 on Linux. The verifier authenticates the pinned inputs, regenerates the word with `compress.py` and compares the decompressed payload, replays both words with its own exact checker (identical MOVE/INIT/CLEAR sequence with identical rows of every moved field, all 799 endpoint rows), runs PR5827's `local.py` unmodified (equal paid profile, helper profile, inventory, rank mass; dense transpose passes), rejects two controls (doubled merged coefficient, deleted live ADD) and compares `RESULT.json` in full. Marker `PASS_P104_ORDINARY_EVENT_COMPRESSION`; `check_research_commit.py` passes. Finite checks only; not run: PR5907's full chain on the compressed word.

See the package README: rerun the PR5907 same-rung-structure search on the compressed word; try a global ordinary re-synthesis for more headroom; a maintainer statement on which allowances are contractual.
